messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-12-15] handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction: The 2025-11-18 note about the indexer named the wrong team. The Dune team took it over on that date; the Ember team did not.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29-2: The Cinder team noticed that search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-11-07] standup/boreal/2025-11-07: We agreed today that search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. The reason is that incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2025-09-15] standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2: Team Boreal still owns search-indexer, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-02-28] handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer: Quick one: the indexer belongs to the Boreal team starting today. Thanks to Cinder for running it until now.
- [2025-08-13] standup/boreal/2025-08-13: The search indexer must stay on OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. Reminder that reporting depends on the ledger.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-03-16] standup/ember/2026-03-16: Oskar has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez. Ember noticed that search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-11-18] handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer: Handover: as of today the indexer moves from Boreal to Ember. Marcus walked Oskar through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-10-27] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (the search indexer, 2025-10-24). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-03-03] standup/boreal/2025-03-03: Dependency map update: the search indexer needs the product catalog (product documents).
- [2025-04-18] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Incident review INC-2025-011. Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13. Root cause: an index missing after the schema migration. Decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, Ledger is owned by team Atlas.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team. Cinder owns the indexer.
- [2025-12-31] standup/atlas/2025-12-31: The Atlas team noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for billing-api: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season). Observation from the Atlas team: after Tuesday's deploy, search-indexer's p99 latency doubled.
- [2026-04-29] standup/ember/2026-04-29: Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: For the record, image-resizer is owned by team Dune.
- [2025-08-20] standup/cinder/2025-08-20: Decision: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, because feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical. Cinder noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-30] standup/atlas/2025-05-30: The ledger is pinned to Postgres 14; the pin lifts when the partitioning work finishes.
- [2025-03-06] incident-review/INC-2025-004: INC-2025-004 review. What happened: notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04. Why: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Follow-up decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2026-04-29] handover/2026-04-29-ledger: Cinder is taking over the ledger from team Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.

Question: Which note corrected the recorded owner of search-indexer, and when?
